npi.title: NPI
npi.description: Ten-digit National Provider Identifier from the CMS pending file and NPPES Registry.

first_name.title: First name
first_name.description: Provider first name reported by NPPES, falling back to the CMS pending-file name when needed.

last_name.title: Last name
last_name.description: Provider last name reported by NPPES, falling back to the CMS pending-file name when needed.

credential.title: Credential
credential.description: Credential text currently reported in the public NPPES record; it may be blank or stale.

enumeration_type.title: NPI enumeration type
enumeration_type.description: NPPES entity type for the NPI, typically NPI-1 for an individual clinician.

focus.title: Behavioral-health focus
focus.description: Plain-language label for the matched conservative behavioral-health taxonomy.

taxonomy_code.title: Taxonomy code
taxonomy_code.description: Matched healthcare provider taxonomy code disclosed in NPPES.

taxonomy_description.title: Taxonomy description
taxonomy_description.description: NPPES description associated with the matched taxonomy code.

address_1.title: Practice address line 1
address_1.description: Public NPPES practice-location address line; verify before operational use.

address_2.title: Practice address line 2
address_2.description: Optional second public NPPES practice-location address line.

city.title: City
city.description: City from the public NPPES practice-location address.

state.title: State or territory
state.description: Two-letter state or territory code from the NPPES practice location.

postal_code.title: Postal code
postal_code.description: Postal code from the public NPPES practice-location address.

telephone.title: Telephone
telephone.description: Public NPPES practice-location telephone; it may be old or shared.

npi_enumeration_date.title: NPI enumeration date
npi_enumeration_date.description: NPI enumeration date currently reported by NPPES, in YYYY-MM-DD format when available.

npi_last_updated.title: NPI last updated
npi_last_updated.description: Most recent NPPES update date, in YYYY-MM-DD format when available.

npi_status.title: NPI status
npi_status.description: NPI status currently reported by NPPES; this is separate from Medicare enrollment status.

pending_status.title: Pending-status definition
pending_status.description: Explicit boundary that the first-time Medicare enrollment application remains under contractor review and is not approved.
pending_status.example: First-time Medicare enrollment application pending Medicare Administrative Contractor processing; not approved or enrolled.

pending_file.title: CMS pending file
pending_file.description: CMS source file in which the NPI newly appeared.

pending_added_date.title: Current snapshot date
pending_added_date.description: Publication date of the newest CMS pending snapshot used for this row.

prior_snapshot_date.title: Prior snapshot date
prior_snapshot_date.description: Publication date of the immediately preceding CMS pending snapshot used for the diff.

cms_pending_source_url.title: CMS source URL
cms_pending_source_url.description: Direct official CMS URL for the current pending-file snapshot.

nppes_registry_url.title: NPPES Registry URL
nppes_registry_url.description: Direct public NPPES provider-view URL for this NPI.

limitations.title: Material limitations
limitations.description: Required limitations for interpreting the pending-enrollment and NPPES data.
limitations.example: Pending does not mean approved. Verify every record before operational use.
